title: The character sheet
text: Four attributes, four skills under each, then Actions, Armor, Health and Essence.

title: Social circles
text: Eleven circles; a contact, friend or patron in each, rated as a tool [6L]/[9M]/[12S].

title: Starting a character
text: 100 points and 60 Essence. Everything starts at 1; Actions 2, armor 0, ¥100; two contacts free.

title: Skill prices
text: Ratings 2–3 cost 1 each, 4–6 cost 2, 7–9 cost 3. Buy up to 9. Magic is capped at Essence ÷ 10.

title: Metatypes
text: Human, elf, dwarf, ork, troll and what each changes.

title: Attribute increases
text: +1 to an attribute costs 7 points; +2 costs 25.

title: Lifestyle
text: Poor, normal or rich: cash up front and a tool rating.

title: Cyberware
text: Fifteen implants, each with an Essence cost and a point cost.

title: Weapons & gear
text: Weapons with damage codes, armor outfits, foci, ammo and services.

title: Vehicles & drones
text: Bikes to gunships and drones: HP, armor, speed, mounts.

title: Chips
text: Destroy, Read, Edit and Control programs in four tiers.

title: Decks
text: A deck sets hacking Actions and armor.

title: Summons
text: How spirits and elementals are called and how they take damage.

title: Magic traditions
text: Shaman, Hermetic or Physical Adept, 30 points each; projection and elemental summoning 10.

title: Spells
text: Eighteen spells at 3 points each.

title: Spirits & elementals
text: Four elementals and six spirits with their extra skills.

title: Attempt rolls
text: Roll dice equal to the skill against TN 6 − attribute. 1 success works; every 2 more is a bonus. Sixes carry on.

title: Challenges & bonuses
text: Challenges have a rating and armor; tools have penetration and effect. Bonuses cut armor, raise effect or keep you quiet.

title: Turns & actions
text: Six-second turns. Everyone acts once per round until Actions run out; order by Actions, Coordination, Palming.

title: Downtime
text: A few quiet hours: legwork, buying, summoning, healing. Checks are best effort and are not rerolled.

title: Combat & damage
text: Health is 3 + Body. Any damage is +1 TN, four or more is +3. Armor above penetration stops it; above half makes it bashing.

title: Soak
text: Once a turn, roll Soak with Body to take off 1 damage, plus 1 per bonus.

title: Healing & recovery
text: Recovery rolls use Soak and Body. One treatment and one Heal per day; one free roll between sessions.

title: Specific skill checks
text: Which skill covers intimidation, perception, demolitions and so on, and when to swap attributes.

title: Magic
text: Casting costs an action and 2 bashing Drain; bonuses cut Drain or double duration. Astral sight and projection.

title: Wards & Ward Working
text: Wards raise spell TNs inside them and strip spells; Ward Working makes or breaks them.

title: Hacking
text: Wired on site; a deck sets Actions and armor; each operation is a challenge with its chip.

title: Legwork & social circles
text: Downtime legwork through Network and your circles; hire a missing contact for ¥200 a roll.

title: Legality, concealment & stealth
text: Licences, fines, concealment and getting gear past a pat-down.

title: Tools
text: Repairs and tool sets through Tools in downtime.

title: ICE & deckers
text: White, grey and black ICE, and other deckers.

title: Karma & purchases
text: 1–2 karma a session, spent like points. Ratings 10–12 cost 4 each, up to 12. Cash price (pts)² × ¥200.
